verdict.rationale: Appwrite is a BaaS with a documented REST and GraphQL API, so a downloadable machine-readable spec is a fair thing to ask for. The evidence pack never mentions an OpenAPI/Swagger file, a GraphQL schema download, or any equivalent spec artifact. The llms.txt file, docs-as-Markdown, Skills, and the MCP server are adjacent AI-context features, not an API specification, so they earn no credit here.
